name: living-code
description: A color scheme for editors, terminals and the web.
author: Elliot Luque

scripts.package:all: pnpm run package:vscode && pnpm run package:jetbrains && pnpm run package:sublime && pnpm run package:chrome && pnpm run package:firefox && pnpm run package:extras
scripts.test: node --test scripts/recolor.test.mjs scripts/expressive-code.test.mjs scripts/git.test.mjs scripts/npm-packages.test.mjs scripts/resolve.test.mjs scripts/preview.test.mjs scripts/readme.test.mjs scripts/vscode.test.mjs scripts/zed.test.mjs scripts/sublime.test.mjs scripts/jetbrains.test.mjs scripts/chrome.test.mjs scripts/apps.test.mjs scripts/terminals.test.mjs scripts/install.test.mjs scripts/release.test.mjs
scripts.package:vscode: mkdir -p dist/vscode && cd extras/vscode && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../../dist/vscode/living-code-$npm_package_version.vsix
